name: Kagami Mao
source: A strong Mahjong player with a seemingly miraculous ability to get any hand he needs at any moment and superhuman sleight of hand. Determined to become the strongest Mahjong player in the world.
translation: A strong Mahjong player with a seemingly miraculous ability to get any hand he needs at any moment and superhuman sleight of hand. Determined to become the strongest Mahjong player in the world.
